cohort: 94 HIV-exposed uninfected (HEU) infants participating in an experimental HIV vaccine trial
finding: Infant growth in this population was multifactorial, with lower LAZ in infants delivered by cesarean section, and depressed WAZ and LAZ in infants with longer ART exposure and those of mothers with lower education levels.
mod_finding: Infants delivered by cesarean section had significantly lower LAZ during the first year of life.
